notes: Being shut in a mall under a list of rules while paranormal events escalate is mascot horror — one enclosed venue, a presence that is somewhere in it, and places to break its sightlines — so Survival leads and the preset is Mascot Horror on interior-single, the mall being the entire map with no exterior to generate. The prompt names a second-floor furniture store and a third floor with windows, so floors genuinely sit above each other and the overhang earns P2; the stores are rooms inside the one interior rather than separate buildings, so nothing needs a P3 transition, and I treated the entrance as the spawn at the doors rather than building an outside. I dropped the preset's gate-escape because the rules say no leaving and the answers end the week with a last day rather than an escape, which makes this an outlast build like disaster survival. Both modes reuse the same mall per the answers, so it is one map, and the menu screens and lobby creation are UI with no layout footprint; the entity itself is never shown, so I filed the paranormal source as a hostile origin with patrolled ground.
